titulo_video: THINGS HEAT UP BETWEEN THEM BUT THE NIGHT HIDES A DANGER! Manhwa Recap The Inheritor Ch 14

locucoes.text: Joo Inhyuk is at the center of a life-or-death situation where every second defines his survival, facing immediate danger.
The scene keeps that intensity, carrying that heavy atmosphere we already know so well.
The pace stays frantic, with our protagonist trapped in the middle of all this chaos.
The tension doesn't let up one bit, leaving us even more curious about what comes next.
Look at this, u-uunh?! She lets out a very audible uunh!! moan.
Meanwhile, the woman breathes heavily and liquid drips down, making the atmosphere even more tense.
After a brief pause, the story heats up again, keeping the viewer glued to the screen.
Suddenly, night falls, revealing a starry sky with the bright moon illuminating the entire scene.
Under this moonlight, the school building appears solitary and imposing in the darkness.
But right then, the roof starts to shake with a strange noise that echoes everywhere.
Right after, a door slowly opens, revealing what's happening inside.
Two bags drop to the floor with a dry impact, causing an unexpected scare.
With the impact sound echoing, the environment empties all of a sudden, leaving him alone.
He goes over everything in silence, trying to understand the sudden loneliness, until his gaze shifts direction.
That's when our boy widens his eyes, fixing them on something in front of him.
What do you mean, what's wrong? He stares at the woman in the kitchen and asks what's wrong.
It's just... what happened before...?
His heart races with the sound of "dugeun" in his chest, making the atmosphere unbearable.
Says it's so vivid in my head, damn.
Look, yeah.
Then comes an unexpected comment about the first time happening outdoors of all places.
Ah, true!
Right after, the two remain seated very close to each other, in complete silence.
The proximity weighs heavy in the air, and the urge to laugh escapes before they can hold back the joke.
He tries to hide his smile with a touch to his face, completely awkward about the situation.
I don't know what to say, for God's sake.
I haven't even known you that long, Yeseul, and so much has already happened.
I... true, I'm glad you're having fun.
Master and slave... look at this guy's style.
Right after, he closes his eyes and lets silence take over the entire conversation.
Yes?
How do I become... ...a good master?
The question hangs in the air while the young man stays quiet, not showing any reaction.
He keeps his gaze fixed ahead, maintaining a super neutral expression on his face.
I don't know... I think you just need to...
...be more honest with your desires.
Do what you want, your way.
For me, that's enough...
Right then the two stare at each other seriously in the middle of the room, saying absolutely nothing.
Libido... look at this guy's thoughts, man.
I-it was nothing, huh?
You must be tired, you can shower before me, let's just shower and sleep.
Okay, got it.
The young man watches the woman with impressive seriousness, maintaining his firm and cold posture.
He starts examining every corner of the house with an extremely suspicious and attentive look.
Will trouble come around, or is the problem that calm never lasts very long?
